name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Enersaunapart.com indoor and outdoor infrared sauna suits offer you a wealth of health benefits. The Far Infrared technology will help with weight loss as increased heart rate at the optimum temperature will burn more calories. The Near Infrared technology will also help with a range of health benefits from detoxification to improved circulation, both of which will enhance your skin tone through purification.



Enersaunapart.com infrared saunas are ideal for relaxation. Made from the highest quality hemlock spruce wood, not only is the sauna attractive to the eye it has a divine natural scent which has a calming effect. This, combined with the comfortable seating, soothing lighting and quality CD player make using Wasauna infrared sauna suit perfect for immediately reducing stress and improving wellbeing.



Enersaunapart.com Infrared Saunas come in a range of sizes. The two person sauna cabins are a good size and the large glass doors add to the feeling of spaciousness. Despite being a solid construction, it is also a portable design adding to its functionality. Wasauna also build larger infrared sauna suits that can comfortably fit up to six people. This allows you to invite friends over for a traditional sauna party. You and your guests can comfortably relax and enjoy the health and wellness benefits of your infrared sauna.
